metadata.title: Bioregional Vitality: Healthcare as Stewardship
metadata.notes: Community-based preventative health and emergency resilience.

nodes.title: First-Line Emergency Care
nodes.description: Stabilizing trauma in off-grid environments. Using the mesh for triage coordination. Hemorrhage control, airway management, and shock protocols.

nodes.title: Microbial Sanitation & Water Testing
nodes.description: Pathogen identification in community water sources. Designing low-cost sanitation loops. Managing cross-contamination in shared labs.

nodes.title: Soil-to-Body Nutrition
nodes.description: The link between soil health and human metabolic health. Nutrient density analysis of regenerative vs conventional crops. Designing local food as medicine.

nodes.title: Phytochemistry & Local Herbalism
nodes.description: Extraction and application of local medicinal plants. Binding traditional plant knowledge to scientific chemical profiles in the HDC mesh.

nodes.title: The Community Vitality Capstone
nodes.description: Design and pilot a community-scale health or nutrition intervention. Must involve IoT tracking of bio-regional health markers and peer validation.

holonic_capstone.deliverable: A functioning health post or nutrition point with 30 days of verified community impact telemetry.

edges.rationale: Indigenous knowledge of local flora is the prerequisite for applied phytochemistry.
Water stewardship mastery is required for advanced sanitation design.
One cannot steward a vitality hub without emergency care mastery.
